tp_search_summary: Grepped the repo (excluding node_modules/.git/target, Rust and CHANGELOG) for 'setIcon'. Hits: definitions on Submenu, IconMenuItem, Window and TrayIcon, a JSDoc example, examples/api/src/components/MenuBuilder.svelte:267 ((item.menu as IconMenuItem)?.setIcon, where item.menu is only ever created by MenuItem/IconMenuItem/CheckMenuItem/PredefinedMenuItem.new, never a Submenu), and examples/api/src/views/Window.svelte:187 (selectedWebview is a WebviewWindow, which resolves to Window.setIcon). crates/tauri/scripts/bundle.global.js is a minified build of the definitions. No Submenu instance ever receives setIcon.
rationale: Submenu.setIcon has no in-repo caller. Both example-app setIcon calls run on receivers that are never Submenu instances (an IconMenuItem built by MenuBuilder's create(), and a WebviewWindow/Window). It is public API reached only by external consumers.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The single prior tp verdict is correct.
